headerDisplay: Bridges TELETASK DoIP devices into HomeKit. Requires an active TDS15132 (DoIP Open Protocol) license on your central unit — see the plugin README.

port.title: Port
port.description: DoIP port — leave at 55957 unless you changed it in PROSOFT.

autoDiscover.title: Auto-Discover Outputs on Startup
autoDiscover.description: Probe the unit at startup and add any new outputs, including flags (probed on central unit 0). "Once" runs on the next restart then sets itself back to Off.

defaultExpose.title: Default Climate Exposure
defaultExpose.description: How climate zones are exposed unless overridden per zone. Pick one — exposing a zone to both HomeKit and Matter puts two controllers on the same zone and floods the central unit. Matter needs Matter enabled on this (child) bridge and a separate pairing — see the README.

outputId.title: Output #
outputId.description: Output number from PROSOFT (GUISOFT → Define Output).

visible.title: Visible in HomeKit
visible.description: Uncheck to keep in config but hide from HomeKit.

centralUnit.title: Central Unit (Optional)
centralUnit.description: Overrides the default central unit for this accessory.

expose.title: Expose As
expose.description: How to expose this zone — pick one. "Home Default" follows the top-level Default Climate Exposure setting. Exposing a zone to both HomeKit and Matter at once puts two controllers on the same zone and floods the central unit, so it is no longer offered. Matter needs Matter enabled on this (child) bridge and a separate pairing.

temperatureFrom.title: Borrow Temperature From Zone
temperatureFrom.description: Read temperature from another zone (for AC with no sensor of its own).

powerRelay.title: On/Off via Relay
powerRelay.description: Relay output used for true on/off.

writable.title: Writable (HomeKit can set the flag)
writable.description: Flag only: whether HomeKit may SET this flag (and its panel LED), not just read it. On by default — set to false for a read-only flag. Note: if the flag drives PROSOFT logic (a mood, relay or condition), a HomeKit write or a tile tap will actuate it.

prosoftRef.title: TELETASK Reference
prosoftRef.description: Auto-filled TELETASK id for this output (e.g. SEN 04, MOT 03, REL 05, DIM 01, FLG 01). Read-only — the plugin derives it from the type and output number; look the accessory up under that code in PROSOFT. Blank until you set the type and number on a new accessory.
